EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
NOTICE UNDER SECTION 10A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha

I, Sajith Wasantha Welgama, Returning Officer of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha, do hereby declare under Section10A(1)(a) of the (Chapter 262) Local Authorities Elections Ordinance that Mrs. Muhandiram Ralalage Dammika UdayanganiPushpakumari of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha as sheceased to be a member of the United People’s Freedom Alliance.
SAJITH WASANTHA WELGAMA,Returning Officer,Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Election Office,Kegalle,22nd November, 2019.

NOTICE UNDER SECTION 10A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha

I, Sajith Wasantha Welgama, Returning Officer of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha, do hereby declare under Section10A(1)(a) of the (Chapter 262) Local Authorities Elections Ordinance that Mr. Karapane Mahaarachchilalage ChandrasiriBandara of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha as he ceased to bea member of the United People’s Freedom Alliance.
